description: Tutorial lesson T6 (Krumpin'), mouse player path: boot from the tutorial_t6_fight fixture -> End Pile In -> select the Boyz in the fight list -> in the attack dialog pick a melee weapon + the Custodian Guard, Weapon to Target, Fight! -> Fast Roll the dice dock and Done -> end the phase. The attack dialog and allocation overlay are embedded modal Windows, so their controls are driven via the emit escape hatch.

steps.comment: the SHUFFLE UP! step claims the Boyz are already in contact - no model base anywhere on the board may overlap another (the Custodian Guard used to sit on a 60px pitch, 3px inside each other's 40mm bases)
5 front-rank Boyz + the Warboss are in real base-to-base contact with the Custodian Guard
every Boy can actually swing - two used to sit >2" from the Custodes and could not fight at all
da boss is in engagement range too
the Warboss token is actually drawn - the fixture used to leave the attached character at UNDEPLOYED, so Main._recreate_unit_visuals() skipped it and da boss was invisible on the board
the attack dialog is an embedded modal Window - select+emit is the click equivalent for its ItemLists
clear whichever defender card or dock step is up (tolerant no-op when the activation already finished)
the Warboss has not fought, so the unfought-units warning (embedded modal AcceptDialog on /root, Main.gd:11123) needs confirming
